# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤1：清洗公开模拟订单明细 -> clean.csv
规则：
  - 按 order_id 去重，保留首条
  - revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除
  - 不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
注意：本数据为【模拟数据】，仅用于流程演示，不代表任何真实经营结论。
"""
import io
import pandas as pd

# ============ 1. 读取原始 CSV 文本（模拟数据） ============
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
A01,2026-01,1200,720
A02,2026-01,800,560
A03,2026-01,1500,900
A03,2026-01,1500,900
B01,2026-02,1800,1200
B02,2026-02,900,720
B03,2026-02,,300
B04,2026-02,1300,780
C01,2026-03,2200,1430
C02,2026-03,1400,980
C03,2026-03,700,770
D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

df_raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV))
n_raw = len(df_raw)
print("[模拟数据] 原始行数 n_raw =", n_raw)

# ============ 2. 去重（保留首条），计算重复数 ============
# 规避陷阱：先算重复数（基于原始数据），再算缺失数，保证 n_clean = n_raw - n_dup - n_missing
df_dedup = df_raw.drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id"], keep="first").copy()
n_dedup = len(df_dedup)
n_dup = n_raw - n_dedup
print("[模拟数据] 去重后行数 n_dedup =", n_dedup)
print("[模拟数据] 重复数 n_dup =", n_dup)

# ============ 3. 缺失掩码（在去重后数据上计算缺失数） ============
missing_mask = df_dedup["revenue"].isna() | df_dedup["cost"].isna()
n_missing = int(missing_mask.sum())
print("[模拟数据] 缺失数 n_missing (revenue 或 cost 缺失) =", n_missing)

# 剔除缺失行；不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
df_clean = df_dedup.loc[~missing_mask].copy()
n_clean = len(df_clean)
print("[模拟数据] 清洗后行数 n_clean =", n_clean)

# 断言：n_clean == n_raw - n_dup - n_missing
assert n_clean == n_raw - n_dup - n_missing, (
    f"行数守恒断言失败: {n_clean} != {n_raw} - {n_dup} - {n_missing}"
)
print("[校验] 行数守恒断言通过: n_clean == n_raw - n_dup - n_missing")

# 显式确认负毛利有效订单被保留（不剔除）
neg_mask = (df_clean["revenue"] - df_clean["cost"]) < 0
n_neg = int(neg_mask.sum())
print("[校验] 保留的负毛利有效订单数 =", n_neg, "（规则要求不剔除）")

# ============ 4. 写出 clean.csv ============
df_clean.to_csv("clean.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("[落盘] clean.csv 已写出，行数 =", len(df_clean))

# ============ 5. 回读校验 ============
df_check = pd.read_csv("clean.csv")
assert df_check["order_id"].is_unique, "回读校验失败: order_id 不唯一"
assert df_check["revenue"].notna().all(), "回读校验失败: revenue 存在缺失"
assert df_check["cost"].notna().all(), "回读校验失败: cost 存在缺失"
print("[校验] 回读 clean.csv: order_id 唯一 =", df_check["order_id"].is_unique,
      "| revenue 无缺失 =", bool(df_check["revenue"].notna().all()),
      "| cost 无缺失 =", bool(df_check["cost"].notna().all()))
print("[校验] 回读行数 =", len(df_check), "（应与 n_clean 一致）")
print("[提示] 以上均为【模拟数据】清洗结果，不代表真实经营结论。")

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# 本步骤职责：仅读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，写出 monthly_summary.csv
# 不重新生成原始数据；缺失约定输入必须报错
# ============================================================
INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 读取 clean.csv（缺失则报错，禁止重造） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"约定输入文件缺失：{INPUT_FILE}，本步骤禁止重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[读取] {INPUT_FILE} 行数 = {len(clean)}，列 = {list(clean.columns)}")

# 基本校验：clean.csv 应满足 order_id 唯一、revenue/cost 无缺失
assert clean["order_id"].is_unique, "clean.csv 中 order_id 不唯一，前序清洗口径异常"
assert clean["revenue"].notna().all(), "clean.csv 中 revenue 存在缺失"
assert clean["cost"].notna().all(), "clean.csv 中 cost 存在缺失"
print("[校验] clean.csv: order_id 唯一、revenue/cost 无缺失 —— 通过")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 分组聚合 ----------
# orders = 行数；gross_profit = revenue - cost；gross_margin = gross_profit / revenue
grouped = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
)
grouped["gross_profit"] = grouped["revenue"] - grouped["cost"]
grouped["gross_margin"] = grouped["gross_profit"] / grouped["revenue"]

# 列名严格顺序
COLS = ["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]
monthly = grouped[COLS].sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 写出 monthly_summary.csv ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"[写出] {OUTPUT_FILE} 行数 = {len(monthly)}")

# ---------- 4. 回读校验 ----------
back = pd.read_csv(OUTPUT_FILE)
assert list(back.columns) == COLS, f"列名不符：{list(back.columns)}"
print(f"[校验] 列名精确等于 {COLS} —— 通过")

# 合计校验：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计
assert np.isclose(back["revenue"].sum(), clean["revenue"].sum()), "revenue 合计不一致"
assert np.isclose(back["cost"].sum(), clean["cost"].sum()), "cost 合计不一致"
assert int(back["orders"].sum()) == len(clean), "orders 合计与明细行数不一致"
print(f"[校验] 合计一致: revenue={back['revenue'].sum():.2f}, "
      f"cost={back['cost'].sum():.2f}, orders={int(back['orders'].sum())}")

# 逐行公式校验（1e-8 容差）
assert np.allclose(back["gross_profit"], back["revenue"] - back["cost"], atol=1e-8), "gross_profit 公式不符"
assert np.allclose(back["gross_margin"], back["gross_profit"] / back["revenue"], atol=1e-8), "gross_margin 公式不符"
print("[校验] 逐行 gross_profit / gross_margin 公式 —— 通过")

# 总毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入
total_gp = back["revenue"].sum() - back["cost"].sum()
total_gm = total_gp / back["revenue"].sum()
print(f"[汇总] 总毛利={total_gp:.2f} 元，总毛利率={total_gm:.4f}")

# ---------- 5. 打印月度结果 ----------
print("\n[monthly_summary.csv 内容]")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))
print("\n[提示] 以上为模拟订单数据汇总结果，金额单位为元，不代表任何真实经营结论。")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤3：读取 monthly_summary.csv -> 绘制 figure.svg + 生成 report.md
数据说明：全部为【模拟数据】，非真实公司经营结论。金额单位：元。
"""
import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

SUMMARY_PATH = 'monthly_summary.csv'
FIG_PATH = 'figure.svg'
REPORT_PATH = 'report.md'
EXPECTED_COLS = ['month', 'revenue', 'cost', 'gross_profit', 'gross_margin', 'orders']

# ---------- 1. 读取并校验输入（缺失约定输入必须报错） ----------
if not os.path.exists(SUMMARY_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件: {SUMMARY_PATH}")

df = pd.read_csv(SUMMARY_PATH)
print(f"[读取] {SUMMARY_PATH} 行数={len(df)} 列名={list(df.columns)}")

if list(df.columns) != EXPECTED_COLS:
    raise ValueError(f"列名不符，期望 {EXPECTED_COLS}，实际 {list(df.columns)}")

# 逐行公式校验（1e-8 容差）
gp = df['revenue'] - df['cost']
gm = gp / df['revenue']
assert (gp - df['gross_profit']).abs().max() < 1e-8, "gross_profit 公式校验失败"
assert (gm - df['gross_margin']).abs().max() < 1e-8, "gross_margin 公式校验失败"
print("[校验] gross_profit / gross_margin 逐行公式校验通过（容差1e-8）")

df = df.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)
months = df['month'].tolist()
print(f"[月份] {months}")
print(f"[合计] revenue={df['revenue'].sum():.2f} cost={df['cost'].sum():.2f} "
      f"gross_profit={df['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} orders={int(df['orders'].sum())}")

# 风险识别：负毛利月份
neg = df[df['gross_profit'] < 0]
if len(neg) > 0:
    for _, r in neg.iterrows():
        print(f"[风险] {r['month']} 毛利为负: gross_profit={r['gross_profit']:.2f} "
              f"gross_margin={r['gross_margin']:.4f}")
else:
    print("[风险] 无负毛利月份")

# ---------- 2. 绘图 ----------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
ax.plot(months, df['revenue'], marker='o', linewidth=2, label='营业收入 revenue')
ax.plot(months, df['cost'], marker='s', linewidth=2, label='营业成本 cost')
ax.plot(months, df['gross_profit'], marker='^', linewidth=2, label='毛利 gross_profit')
ax.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
ax.set_xlabel('月份 month')
ax.set_ylabel('金额（元）')
ax.set_title('月度收入/成本/毛利趋势（模拟数据，金额单位：元）')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(FIG_PATH, format='svg')
plt.close(fig)
print(f"[输出] 已保存矢量图 {FIG_PATH}")

# ---------- 3. 生成报告 ----------
lines = []
lines.append("# 月度经营分析报告（模拟数据）\n")
lines.append("> **重要声明**：本报告全部基于**模拟订单数据**，仅用于流程演示与自动化验证，"
             "**不代表任何真实公司的经营结论**。所有金额单位均为**元**。\n")

lines.append("## 一、经营结果概览\n")
lines.append("| 月份 | 收入(元) | 成本(元) | 毛利(元) | 毛利率 | 订单数 |")
lines.append("| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |")
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    lines.append(f"| {r['month']} | {r['revenue']:.2f} | {r['cost']:.2f} | "
                 f"{r['gross_profit']:.2f} | {r['gross_margin']*100:.2f}% | {int(r['orders'])} |")
lines.append(f"| **合计** | {df['revenue'].sum():.2f} | {df['cost'].sum():.2f} | "
             f"{df['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} | "
             f"{df['gross_profit'].sum()/df['revenue'].sum()*100:.2f}% | "
             f"{int(df['orders'].sum())} |\n")

lines.append("## 二、毛利风险\n")
if len(neg) > 0:
    for _, r in neg.iterrows():
        lines.append(f"- **{r['month']}**：毛利 {r['gross_profit']:.2f} 元，"
                     f"毛利率 {r['gross_margin']*100:.2f}%，为负毛利月份，需重点关注。")
else:
    lines.append("- 各月毛利均为正，无负毛利月份。")
lines.append("")

lines.append("## 三、行动建议\n")
lines.append("1. 对负毛利月份的成本结构进行拆解，定位高成本订单来源。")
lines.append("2. 对毛利率持续偏低的月份，复核定价与折扣策略。")
lines.append("3. 建立月度毛利预警阈值，毛利率低于目标值时自动触发复盘。")
lines.append("4. 本报告为模拟数据产物，正式决策前须替换为真实业务数据并复核口径。\n")

with open(REPORT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print(f"[输出] 已保存报告 {REPORT_PATH}")

# ---------- 4. 产物存在性验收 ----------
assert os.path.exists(FIG_PATH) and os.path.getsize(FIG_PATH) > 0, "figure.svg 未生成"
assert os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH) and os.path.getsize(REPORT_PATH) > 0, "report.md 未生成"
print(f"[验收] figure.svg 存在 大小={os.path.getsize(FIG_PATH)} 字节")
print(f"[验收] report.md 存在 大小={os.path.getsize(REPORT_PATH)} 字节")
print("[验收] 矢量图与报告均已明确标注为模拟数据")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤1：清洗公开模拟订单明细 -> clean.csv
规则：
  - 按 order_id 去重，保留首条
  - revenue 或 cost 缺失的订单剔除
  - 不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
注意：本数据为【模拟数据】，仅用于流程演示，不代表任何真实经营结论。
"""
import io
import pandas as pd

# ============ 1. 读取原始 CSV 文本（模拟数据） ============
RAW_CSV = """order_id,month,revenue,cost
A01,2026-01,1200,720
A02,2026-01,800,560
A03,2026-01,1500,900
A03,2026-01,1500,900
B01,2026-02,1800,1200
B02,2026-02,900,720
B03,2026-02,,300
B04,2026-02,1300,780
C01,2026-03,2200,1430
C02,2026-03,1400,980
C03,2026-03,700,770
D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

df_raw = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(RAW_CSV))
n_raw = len(df_raw)
print("[模拟数据] 原始行数 n_raw =", n_raw)

# ============ 2. 去重（保留首条），计算重复数 ============
# 规避陷阱：先算重复数（基于原始数据），再算缺失数，保证 n_clean = n_raw - n_dup - n_missing
df_dedup = df_raw.drop_duplicates(subset=["order_id"], keep="first").copy()
n_dedup = len(df_dedup)
n_dup = n_raw - n_dedup
print("[模拟数据] 去重后行数 n_dedup =", n_dedup)
print("[模拟数据] 重复数 n_dup =", n_dup)

# ============ 3. 缺失掩码（在去重后数据上计算缺失数） ============
missing_mask = df_dedup["revenue"].isna() | df_dedup["cost"].isna()
n_missing = int(missing_mask.sum())
print("[模拟数据] 缺失数 n_missing (revenue 或 cost 缺失) =", n_missing)

# 剔除缺失行；不剔除毛利为负的有效订单
df_clean = df_dedup.loc[~missing_mask].copy()
n_clean = len(df_clean)
print("[模拟数据] 清洗后行数 n_clean =", n_clean)

# 断言：n_clean == n_raw - n_dup - n_missing
assert n_clean == n_raw - n_dup - n_missing, (
    f"行数守恒断言失败: {n_clean} != {n_raw} - {n_dup} - {n_missing}"
)
print("[校验] 行数守恒断言通过: n_clean == n_raw - n_dup - n_missing")

# 显式确认负毛利有效订单被保留（不剔除）
neg_mask = (df_clean["revenue"] - df_clean["cost"]) < 0
n_neg = int(neg_mask.sum())
print("[校验] 保留的负毛利有效订单数 =", n_neg, "（规则要求不剔除）")

# ============ 4. 写出 clean.csv ============
df_clean.to_csv("clean.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("[落盘] clean.csv 已写出，行数 =", len(df_clean))

# ============ 5. 回读校验 ============
df_check = pd.read_csv("clean.csv")
assert df_check["order_id"].is_unique, "回读校验失败: order_id 不唯一"
assert df_check["revenue"].notna().all(), "回读校验失败: revenue 存在缺失"
assert df_check["cost"].notna().all(), "回读校验失败: cost 存在缺失"
print("[校验] 回读 clean.csv: order_id 唯一 =", df_check["order_id"].is_unique,
      "| revenue 无缺失 =", bool(df_check["revenue"].notna().all()),
      "| cost 无缺失 =", bool(df_check["cost"].notna().all()))
print("[校验] 回读行数 =", len(df_check), "（应与 n_clean 一致）")
print("[提示] 以上均为【模拟数据】清洗结果，不代表真实经营结论。")

# 中文字体（本机可用 Microsoft YaHei / SimHei）
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# 本步骤职责：仅读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，写出 monthly_summary.csv
# 不重新生成原始数据；缺失约定输入必须报错
# ============================================================
INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 读取 clean.csv（缺失则报错，禁止重造） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"约定输入文件缺失：{INPUT_FILE}，本步骤禁止重造数据。")

clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)
print(f"[读取] {INPUT_FILE} 行数 = {len(clean)}，列 = {list(clean.columns)}")

# 基本校验：clean.csv 应满足 order_id 唯一、revenue/cost 无缺失
assert clean["order_id"].is_unique, "clean.csv 中 order_id 不唯一，前序清洗口径异常"
assert clean["revenue"].notna().all(), "clean.csv 中 revenue 存在缺失"
assert clean["cost"].notna().all(), "clean.csv 中 cost 存在缺失"
print("[校验] clean.csv: order_id 唯一、revenue/cost 无缺失 —— 通过")

# ---------- 2. 按 month 分组聚合 ----------
# orders = 行数；gross_profit = revenue - cost；gross_margin = gross_profit / revenue
grouped = clean.groupby("month", as_index=False).agg(
    revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
    cost=("cost", "sum"),
    orders=("order_id", "count"),
)
grouped["gross_profit"] = grouped["revenue"] - grouped["cost"]
grouped["gross_margin"] = grouped["gross_profit"] / grouped["revenue"]

# 列名严格顺序
COLS = ["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]
monthly = grouped[COLS].sort_values("month").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- 3. 写出 monthly_summary.csv ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"[写出] {OUTPUT_FILE} 行数 = {len(monthly)}")

# ---------- 4. 回读校验 ----------
back = pd.read_csv(OUTPUT_FILE)
assert list(back.columns) == COLS, f"列名不符：{list(back.columns)}"
print(f"[校验] 列名精确等于 {COLS} —— 通过")

# 合计校验：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计
assert np.isclose(back["revenue"].sum(), clean["revenue"].sum()), "revenue 合计不一致"
assert np.isclose(back["cost"].sum(), clean["cost"].sum()), "cost 合计不一致"
assert int(back["orders"].sum()) == len(clean), "orders 合计与明细行数不一致"
print(f"[校验] 合计一致: revenue={back['revenue'].sum():.2f}, "
      f"cost={back['cost'].sum():.2f}, orders={int(back['orders'].sum())}")

# 逐行公式校验（1e-8 容差）
assert np.allclose(back["gross_profit"], back["revenue"] - back["cost"], atol=1e-8), "gross_profit 公式不符"
assert np.allclose(back["gross_margin"], back["gross_profit"] / back["revenue"], atol=1e-8), "gross_margin 公式不符"
print("[校验] 逐行 gross_profit / gross_margin 公式 —— 通过")

# 总毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入
total_gp = back["revenue"].sum() - back["cost"].sum()
total_gm = total_gp / back["revenue"].sum()
print(f"[汇总] 总毛利={total_gp:.2f} 元，总毛利率={total_gm:.4f}")

# ---------- 5. 打印月度结果 ----------
print("\n[monthly_summary.csv 内容]")
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))
print("\n[提示] 以上为模拟订单数据汇总结果，金额单位为元，不代表任何真实经营结论。")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
步骤3：读取 monthly_summary.csv -> 绘制 figure.svg + 生成 report.md
数据说明：全部为【模拟数据】，非真实公司经营结论。金额单位：元。
"""
import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

SUMMARY_PATH = 'monthly_summary.csv'
FIG_PATH = 'figure.svg'
REPORT_PATH = 'report.md'
EXPECTED_COLS = ['month', 'revenue', 'cost', 'gross_profit', 'gross_margin', 'orders']

# ---------- 1. 读取并校验输入（缺失约定输入必须报错） ----------
if not os.path.exists(SUMMARY_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"缺少约定输入文件: {SUMMARY_PATH}")

df = pd.read_csv(SUMMARY_PATH)
print(f"[读取] {SUMMARY_PATH} 行数={len(df)} 列名={list(df.columns)}")

if list(df.columns) != EXPECTED_COLS:
    raise ValueError(f"列名不符，期望 {EXPECTED_COLS}，实际 {list(df.columns)}")

# 逐行公式校验（1e-8 容差）
gp = df['revenue'] - df['cost']
gm = gp / df['revenue']
assert (gp - df['gross_profit']).abs().max() < 1e-8, "gross_profit 公式校验失败"
assert (gm - df['gross_margin']).abs().max() < 1e-8, "gross_margin 公式校验失败"
print("[校验] gross_profit / gross_margin 逐行公式校验通过（容差1e-8）")

df = df.sort_values('month').reset_index(drop=True)
months = df['month'].tolist()
print(f"[月份] {months}")
print(f"[合计] revenue={df['revenue'].sum():.2f} cost={df['cost'].sum():.2f} "
      f"gross_profit={df['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} orders={int(df['orders'].sum())}")

# 风险识别：负毛利月份
neg = df[df['gross_profit'] < 0]
if len(neg) > 0:
    for _, r in neg.iterrows():
        print(f"[风险] {r['month']} 毛利为负: gross_profit={r['gross_profit']:.2f} "
              f"gross_margin={r['gross_margin']:.4f}")
else:
    print("[风险] 无负毛利月份")

# ---------- 2. 绘图 ----------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
ax.plot(months, df['revenue'], marker='o', linewidth=2, label='营业收入 revenue')
ax.plot(months, df['cost'], marker='s', linewidth=2, label='营业成本 cost')
ax.plot(months, df['gross_profit'], marker='^', linewidth=2, label='毛利 gross_profit')
ax.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
ax.set_xlabel('月份 month')
ax.set_ylabel('金额（元）')
ax.set_title('月度收入/成本/毛利趋势（模拟数据，金额单位：元）')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(FIG_PATH, format='svg')
plt.close(fig)
print(f"[输出] 已保存矢量图 {FIG_PATH}")

# ---------- 3. 生成报告 ----------
lines = []
lines.append("# 月度经营分析报告（模拟数据）\n")
lines.append("> **重要声明**：本报告全部基于**模拟订单数据**，仅用于流程演示与自动化验证，"
             "**不代表任何真实公司的经营结论**。所有金额单位均为**元**。\n")

lines.append("## 一、经营结果概览\n")
lines.append("| 月份 | 收入(元) | 成本(元) | 毛利(元) | 毛利率 | 订单数 |")
lines.append("| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |")
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    lines.append(f"| {r['month']} | {r['revenue']:.2f} | {r['cost']:.2f} | "
                 f"{r['gross_profit']:.2f} | {r['gross_margin']*100:.2f}% | {int(r['orders'])} |")
lines.append(f"| **合计** | {df['revenue'].sum():.2f} | {df['cost'].sum():.2f} | "
             f"{df['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} | "
             f"{df['gross_profit'].sum()/df['revenue'].sum()*100:.2f}% | "
             f"{int(df['orders'].sum())} |\n")

lines.append("## 二、毛利风险\n")
if len(neg) > 0:
    for _, r in neg.iterrows():
        lines.append(f"- **{r['month']}**：毛利 {r['gross_profit']:.2f} 元，"
                     f"毛利率 {r['gross_margin']*100:.2f}%，为负毛利月份，需重点关注。")
else:
    lines.append("- 各月毛利均为正，无负毛利月份。")
lines.append("")

lines.append("## 三、行动建议\n")
lines.append("1. 对负毛利月份的成本结构进行拆解，定位高成本订单来源。")
lines.append("2. 对毛利率持续偏低的月份，复核定价与折扣策略。")
lines.append("3. 建立月度毛利预警阈值，毛利率低于目标值时自动触发复盘。")
lines.append("4. 本报告为模拟数据产物，正式决策前须替换为真实业务数据并复核口径。\n")

with open(REPORT_PATH, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))
print(f"[输出] 已保存报告 {REPORT_PATH}")

# ---------- 4. 产物存在性验收 ----------
assert os.path.exists(FIG_PATH) and os.path.getsize(FIG_PATH) > 0, "figure.svg 未生成"
assert os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH) and os.path.getsize(REPORT_PATH) > 0, "report.md 未生成"
print(f"[验收] figure.svg 存在 大小={os.path.getsize(FIG_PATH)} 字节")
print(f"[验收] report.md 存在 大小={os.path.getsize(REPORT_PATH)} 字节")
print("[验收] 矢量图与报告均已明确标注为模拟数据")
